svg.title: Asset tracking: laptops and licences per person — SoftTrack web design mockup (#313)
svg.desc: Who has which laptop is in a spreadsheet that IT keeps. An asset has a kind, a name, a serial number or key, dates and a state; it is assigned to a person from a date, and every assignment is kept; a person’s assets show on their profile to them, to site admins and to HR admins; and licences have seats.
